cohort: The study included 36,387 Caesarean sections performed between 2008 and 2022 at 34 hospitals affiliated with the VINCat programme, involving mothers with a mean age of 33 years.
finding: The overall incidence of surgical site infections significantly decreased from 3.81% in 2008-2012 to 2.66% in 2018-2022, primarily due to a reduction in superficial SSIs.
